text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Helllooo, everyone! Did our feelings
reach all of you?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: I received it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I could hear your voices, too.
Your cheers reached me.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course. Otherwise, there would be no point in us putting on this concert.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I will never forget today.
I will never forget all of the cheering voices you gave me."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Together with all of you,
we will keep on running into the future...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deafening cheers and applause
echo throughout the entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Alongside the cheers of the fans, the Umamusume continued singing, one song after another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A song infused with their very own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
......What incredible cheers.
To think we can hear them all the way over here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much.
For helping someone like me all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for letting us... create such a wonderful stage...!"
choice_data_list: The pleasure was all mine, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm so sorry!
In the middle of your conversation..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Saying 'thank you.'

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Senpai is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live,
where the crowd and Umamusume became one in boundless excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even a dreamlike night such as that
must come to an end. And then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days passed.

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone.
That's all for today's lesson!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Falcon-san. If you have time,
would you like to go over that choreography together?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That choreography just now was...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, this choreography is
for the back dancers.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...No way. If we're treating this like the real thing,
smiling is even more out of the question.
I mean, this is backup dancer choreography, right?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know, I don't want to get comfortable with this dance.
Because if I can just smile and dance it normally,
I feel like I'll never reach center position for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since performing in the Grand Live the other day,
I just can't forget the smiles on the fans' faces."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to dance with a smile no matter where I'm positioned.
Because that way..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because I realized...
I want to win next time for this person's sake, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, time to get fired up!
Falco's super strict when it comes to smiles, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Hello! How are plans going
for next year's Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we coordinated with the URA
without a hitch! ...And on that note,
there's something I'd like to consult everyone about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to use this photo
for the next promotional main poster.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A photo?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
Is this from the Grand Live...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What a wonderful photograph.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "Yes. The person who took this photo said so themselves with a smile."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Not wanting to be outdone by them,
I felt an urge to shine as brightly as I could too."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "...and that made me want to cheer for her with everything I've got."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Passing those feelings on to the girls making their debuts, and to those who are becoming new fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: —May I keep the baton moving forward?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Hearing those words from Light Hello, not a single girl shook her head in disagreement."
